module: Reusable ImGui widgets for the layer GUIs of the Dynamic Decals inspector: texture picker (read-only field, folder button, reset button, preview, drag-and-drop target) and four-corner gradient editor for a decal layer. Each modification calls api.setLayer(layer, true). Depends on editor_api_dynamicDecals.
notes: Bug: decalTextureWidgetInspect uses a variable `propert` (typo of `property`, nil global) in the ImGui identifiers; the widgets of two texture properties of the same layer therefore share the same identifier.
Drag-and-drop accepts the payload "DynDecalTextureDrapDrop" (typo in the name); the payload must be 256 bytes (assert), and contains the texture path.
The gradient reads decalGradientColor{TopLeft,TopRight,BottomLeft,BottomRight} (ColorI 0..255) and writes them back as ColorI.
The texture preview is limited by the preference `dynamicDecalsTool.inspector.texturePreviewSize`.

decalTextureWidgetInspect.desc: Draws a texture picker for layer[property]: read-only path, opening of a file dialog (png/jpg/jpeg, default folder /art/decals/dynDecals/), deletion, preview and drop zone. Assigns layer[property] then calls api.setLayer(layer, true).

property.desc: Name of the field containing the texture path.

removeTextureOverridePath.desc: Value put in the property by the delete button; default "/".

decalColorGradientWidgetInspect.desc: Draws a four-corner gradient square with an RGBA color picker at each corner; updates the layer's decalGradientColor* properties.

k.desc: Not used in the function body.

layer.desc: Decal layer containing the four gradient colors.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: stores the tool and the API.
